comparison.objective: Close an open wire-duct run using a cut-to-length cover.
comparison.physical_skill: From the title, bimanually align a long cover and engage it along the duct.
comparison.success_condition: Available evidence has no body or specifications and omits engagement length, seating tolerance, damage rules, and final release criteria.
comparison.reason: The stated ability is long-part alignment and cover closure; geometry alone is not the distinction, but its engagement outcome is meaningfully different from notch fracture and free-fragment recovery.
